## When to use it

For the "you are here" trail, as in the `breadcrumbs` slot of `sherpa-app-header`; the last crumb is the current page and has no link. Give each earlier crumb an `href`, so it is a real `<a href>` link.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-breadcrumbs></sherpa-breadcrumbs>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-breadcrumbs`:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Records",
    "href": "?context=records"
  },
  {
    "label": "Ada Lovelace"
  }
]
```

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`crumbs`, `link`, `trail`

| `--sherpa-display-mode-space-xs` | `.crumb` | `gap` |
| `--sherpa-theme-size-icon-2xs` | `.separator` | `--_icon-size` |
| `--sherpa-theme-content-body-1` | `.separator` | `color` |
| `--sherpa-theme-content-link-1` | `.link` | `color` |
| `--sherpa-font-weight-regular` | `.link` | `font-weight` |
| `--sherpa-theme-content-line-height-small` | `.link` | `line-height` |
| `--sherpa-display-mode-border-rounding-sm` | `.link` | `border-radius` |

## populate()

`[{ label, href? }]`

the crumb trail; the last becomes current. Or its `<a href>` children
